verdict.rationale: The API docs say Custom Fields exist at the List level and can carry over when a task moves to a new List, and that tasks can have custom task types. A hands-on community user specifically praises how quickly ClickUp lets you configure task statuses, especially compared with Jira. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of creating and editing custom fields and status workflows in the product UI, and detail on the range of field types and how far status workflows can be customized.
